text:
Ivy (Support): FYI escalating to CS  were seeing failed activations for a batch of trial tenants after a scheduled infra migration. Tenants show status "activation_pending" and some clients report 500s. Notifying because Verdant Labs has a renewal review in 48h and is in a pilot conversion path.

Marcus (CS): Ack. Can you paste sample error lines and whether a hot manual path exists? We should draft a measured customer note and a short comms + remediation plan.

Ivy (Support): Paste logs: 
```
2026-07-22T02:41:10Z ERROR migrator: migration timeout -> tenant=verdant req=req_x9d1
2026-07-22T02:41:12Z ERROR provisioner: failed to bind resources -> tenant=greenlabs req=req_x9d2
2026-07-22T02:41:15Z WARN webhook: retry loop exceeded -> tenant=fluxhealth
```
Front-end shows spinner with "Activation delayed" for affected accounts.

Tara (CS Ops): Marking Verdant Labs as renewal_urgent in CRM. Marcus, want me to draft outreach? I can also run a targeted one-off migration for VIP tenants via admin tooling.

Marcus (CS): Yes please. Keep tone calm, offer a 15-min verification session, and offer 5 trial days if not resolved within 24h. Eli (Sales) please standby for any credit decisions.

deploy-bot: Post-migration check detected degraded binding rate after canary rollout at 02:30Z. Automated rollback queued; patch to fix binding orchestration will be applied in ~20m. Monitoring metrics and will post updates.

Ivy (Support): Workaround that works for some tenants: use admin console manual-migrate endpoint or CLI fallback: 
```
# admin fallback
./admin migrate --tenant <tenant_id> --mode manual --force
./admin provision --tenant <tenant_id> --confirm
```
Note: this leaves an audit trail and should be used only for VIPs.

Tara (CS Ops): Draft outreach copy below  feedback welcome: 

"Hi <Name>, quick update: an internal migration step impacted activations for a small number of trial accounts, including yours. Our engineers are rolling a fix now and we can run a targeted manual migration for your tenant immediately if youd like — we can also schedule a 15-minute call to validate everything. If this isnt resolved within 24 hours well extend your trial by 5 days. Apologies for the interruption and thanks for your patience.

Please reply if you want us to trigger the manual migration now or join a quick session"

Marcus (CS): Good. Add a one-line ownership: "Contact Marcus <email> for immediate help" and please cc Eli. Also prepare a short internal playbook link for Sales on what credits/extensions to offer.

Eli (Sales): Ill be on Verdants renewal call tomorrow morning. Please dont commit account credits without looping me; a 5-day trial extension is fine as a standard offer. If they push for ARR-level credits escalate to me.

Ivy (Support): Update: rollback completed and patch applied. Binding errors dropped by ~90% in the 10m window. Still seeing a handful of migration timeouts for older tenants; manual migrate succeeds for those.

Tara (CS Ops): Action items: 1) Tara send the note to Verdant + copy Eli; 2) Ivy run manual migrate for Verdant after permission and confirm end-to-end; 3) Marcus flag renewal risk + update CRM; 4) Eli join renewal call and hold credit negotiation. I'll also upload a short post-incident checklist to /docs/cs/incidents once stabilized.

Marcus (CS): Sending outreach now. Will update thread with Verdants response. Thanks all. :thumbsup
